rulesScreen.heading: How to play
rulesScreen.p1:
A wild Pokémon appears as a silhouette!
Name it to win its sticker.
rulesScreen.p2:
▶FIGHT
Type its name to attack. Korean, English and Japanese names all work.
A wrong name costs 1 HP; at 0 HP the game is over!
rulesScreen.p3:
▶BAG
A hint shows half of the name.
It breaks your combo and halves the points.
rulesScreen.p4:
▶POKéMON
Swap for another Pokémon. Up to 3 times per game.
rulesScreen.p5:
▶RUN
End the game and see your results.
Streaks raise your score and your shiny odds. Let's go!
